groups.name: Prabowo Administration and Fiscal Policy
groups.narrative: The new administration faces rising fiscal deficits and potential institutional restructuring regarding commodity exports.
groups.narrative_zh: 新政府面临日益增加的财政赤字，并可能针对大宗商品出口机构进行重组。
groups.R_reason: Economic data and official restructuring plans are binary/measurable.
groups.S_reason: Ministry of Finance and official government gazettes.
groups.U_reason: Economic performance and political decisions are highly volatile.
groups.H_reason: High interest from business and economic media.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Indonesian budget deficit exceed 1% of GDP by the end of Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 到2026年第三季度末，印尼财政赤字会超过GDP的1%吗？

groups.name: Indonesian National Security Deployments
groups.narrative: The Army Chief of Staff is proposing to station a TNI battalion in every district, signaling a shift in internal security strategy.
groups.narrative_zh: 陆军参谋长提议在每个区部署一个TNI营，标志着国内安全战略的转变。
groups.R_reason: Deployment scale is measurable, though specific timelines may shift.
groups.T_reason: Implementation timeline for the fiscal year.
groups.U_reason: Logistical and budgetary feasibility is uncertain.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Indonesian military successfully deploy a full battalion in at least 50% of regencies by year-end 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 到2026年底，印尼军队是否能在至少50%的县/区内部署一个完整营？

groups.name: Rupiah and Economic Stability
groups.narrative: Concerns regarding currency depreciation and broader economic pressure on the Indonesian market.
groups.narrative_zh: 对货币贬值以及印尼市场面临的更广泛经济压力的担忧。
groups.R_reason: Currency values are tracked objectively on forex markets.
groups.suggested_question: Will the USD/IDR exchange rate close above 16,500 on average in June 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年6月美元兑印尼盾平均汇率是否会收于16,500以上？

groups.name: Jokowi Political Influence
groups.narrative: Rumors and signs of former President Jokowi attempting to exert influence on the current administration.
groups.narrative_zh: 关于前总统佐科试图对现任政府施加影响的传闻与迹象。
groups.R_reason: Political influence is qualitative, but can be proxied by appointments or public declarations.
groups.S_reason: Political analysis and mainstream media reports.
groups.H_reason: Highly debated topic in political circles.

groups.name: Energy Security and Infrastructure
groups.narrative: Monitoring fuel stock levels and urban infrastructure challenges in Jakarta.
groups.narrative_zh: 监测燃料库存水平以及雅加达面临的城市基础设施挑战。
groups.R_reason: Fuel stock days are official metrics.
groups.U_reason: Usually managed to stay within stable thresholds.
groups.suggested_question: Will Pertalite national stock days fall below 10 days at any point in Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年第三季度期间，Pertalite国家库存天数是否会跌破10天？

groups.name: International Relations and Gaza
groups.narrative: Indonesia's diplomatic stance on the Gaza conflict and its exclusion from China-ASEAN regional infrastructure projects.
groups.narrative_zh: 印尼在加沙冲突上的外交立场，及其被中国-东盟区域基础设施项目排除在外的情况。
groups.R_reason: Joint statements and treaty signing are clear events, but diplomatic status is complex.
groups.suggested_question: Will Indonesia formally sign a new bilateral infrastructure agreement with China before the end of 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼是否会在2026年底前与中国正式签署新的双边基础设施协议？

groups.name: Public Health and Disease
groups.narrative: Calls for intensified awareness and caution regarding Hantavirus in Indonesia.
groups.narrative_zh: 呼吁加强印尼对汉坦病毒的意识与防范。
groups.R_reason: Public health advisory issued vs not issued.
groups.U_reason: Usually a binary legislative or administrative step.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Indonesian Ministry of Health issue a nationwide health alert for Hantavirus by year-end 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼卫生部是否会在2026年底前发布针对汉坦病毒的全国性健康预警？

groups.name: Sports and International Events
groups.narrative: Performance of Indonesian athletes in international badminton and football, and global football market rumors.
groups.narrative_zh: 印尼运动员在羽毛球和足球上的表现，以及全球足球市场的转会传闻。
groups.R_reason: Game results and tournament outcomes are binary and objective.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Indonesian National Football Team advance to the next round of the World Cup qualifiers in the next match?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼国家足球队是否能在下一场比赛中晋级世界杯预选赛下一阶段？

groups.name: Climate and Weather Trends
groups.narrative: Impact of El Nino weather patterns on Indonesian agriculture and climate stability.
groups.narrative_zh: 厄尔尼诺气候模式对印尼农业及气候稳定性的影响。
groups.S_reason: BMKG (Indonesian Agency for Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics).
groups.H_reason: High public concern due to food security.
groups.suggested_question: Will BMKG declare an El Nino climate event active in Indonesia during Q3 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼气象、气候和地球物理局（BMKG）是否会宣布2026年第三季度印尼处于厄尔尼诺气候事件中？

groups.name: Tech Industry and Consumer Trends
groups.narrative: Samsung product strategy shifting, specifically concerning the discontinuation of the Z Flip line.
groups.narrative_zh: 三星产品策略的转变，特别涉及Z Flip系列的停产。
groups.suggested_question: Will Samsung officially announce the discontinuation of the Galaxy Z Flip line before 2027?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 三星是否会在2027年之前正式宣布停止Galaxy Z Flip系列产品？
